notes.title: Critial bugs with the oil system fixed and performance has been improved
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]We're excited to announce a new update for Lustful Fingers, focusing on stability and user experience improvements.[/p][list][*][p][b]Oil System Fixes:[/b] We've resolved several critical bugs related to the oil system, including issues that caused FPS drops and NullReferenceException errors. You should now experience a much smoother and more reliable pouring and painting experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] In addition to the oil system, we've implemented general performance improvements to ensure a more stable framerate throughout your gameplay session.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Eye" Button is Back:[/b] The "Eye" button, which allows you to visit clients, has been restored to full functionality after its recent maintenance. All previous problems associated with the button have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support! [b]The Lustful Fingers Team[/b][/p]
